features.feature: Approved design record integrity, normative Sections 1 through 27.6, current payload audit envelope, and DYN-1 observe-only versus DYN-3 authority boundary.
Kickoff current-main inventory discovery, stable command identities, frozen digest, and rejection of historical counts as authority.
StoryChangeManifest and dual-revision impact graph cover adds, modifications, deletes, renames, facts, capabilities, pins, and mandatory scope escalation.
Every inventory command has catalog identity, source and runtime closure, risk and resource policy, and process-fact and capability bindings.
Deterministic additive execute, reuse, and unverified selection maintains complete inventory accounting, signed manifests, monotonicity, and fail-closed full escalation.
DYN-1 observe instrumentation preserves full-plan order, verdict, resources, cleanup, and TEST and DONE authority boundaries while comparing against the complete oracle.
DYN-2 source-first per-command receipts and canonical baselines bind build, closure, ancestry, epoch, clean tree, environment, expiry, signature, and revocation.
DYN-2 shadow mode compares per-command and aggregate results to the complete validation oracle and revokes or escalates on mismatch.

DYN-3 permits only eligible local or docs Stories to use dynamic TEST authority after all twelve blocking prerequisites; unsafe changes fall back to complete validation and DONE-required remains independent.
Operational modes, append-only enable and rollback history, structured reports, periodic baselines and audits, and honest warm/cold risk-tier performance reporting.
Historical replay, FI-1 through FI-5, mutation matrix, paired current-head runs, residue checks, and enforce threshold evidence.
DYN-4 stable weighted LPT scheduling enforces CPU capacity, resource claims, drain barriers, timeline persistence, and verdict equivalence.
DYN-5 safe quorum and review-pass sharding uses stable case IDs, exact coverage, end-to-end sentinels, aggregate receipts, routing checks, and residue rejection.
Wave 4 acceptance topology, pre-review, rollout report, and rollout admission are verifier-owned and bound to executable current-head evidence.
Complete current inventory remains the denominator: executed plus admissible reuse covers every row and final unverified, uncovered, and unmapped counts are zero.
Unknown, ambiguous, stale, revoked, malformed, dirty, protected, excluded, or uncertified conditions fail closed to execution or complete-plan escalation.
Full validation remains fallback, high-risk policy, periodic baseline, and audit oracle; focused validation and DONE-required evidence never inherit dynamic authority.
All gate-consumed facts are signed, digest-bound, ancestry-compatible, clean-tree generated, current, and mechanically verifiable.
DYN-4 and DYN-5 remain separate safety-proven optimizations: they do not widen low-risk authority before their own equivalence and mutation evidence, and performance claims are population-specific.
No Story prose, natural-language similarity, LLM score, historical success, heuristic subtraction, or manual low-risk assertion can authorize skipping validation.
Unrelated product behavior changes are excluded from this Story.
Weakening full validation, bypassing DONE-required, or treating focused receipts as dynamic authority is excluded from this Story.

features.feature: A universal 12 to 14 minute completion claim is excluded; reports must distinguish eligible, full-escalated, and pre-sharding populations.
Unrelated framework migration outside the DYN-4 and DYN-5 implementation boundary is excluded.
